The '''Hierarchy of Hatred''' was [[Ysanne Isard]]'s personal plan of how to maximize damage to her enemies. [[Booster Terrik]] attempted to recreate the Hierarchy for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Hegemony theater]].
